players.bio: Alhassan Yusuf Abdullahi (born 18 July 2000) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder. Career IFK Göteborg From 2018 to 2021, Yusuf played for Allsvenskan club IFK Göteborg. Antwerp On 16 July 2021, Belgian club Antwerp announced that they had reached an oral agreement with IFK Göteborg over the transfer of Yusuf.

Allan Oyirwoth (born 23 January 2007) is a Ugandan professional footballer who plays for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution and the Uganda national football team. Early life He is from Pakwach in the West Nile region of Uganda. He attended Kibuli S.S and Amus College in Uganda, and Brooke House College and Academy in Leicester, England.

Andrew Farrell (born April 2, 1992) is an American soccer player who plays as a defender for the New England Revolution of Major League Soccer. He played collegiate soccer at the University of Louisville, where he was an All-American, and had enhanced his draft status with his performance at the MLS Combine.

Brooklyn Sigel Randolph Raines (born March 11, 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution. Born in Liberia, he represents the United States at youth level. Club career Raines started his soccer career at the age of five when he joined Inter FC Chicago. He left for the Barça Residency Academy at the age of thirteen.

Carles Gil de Pareja Vicent (born 22 November 1992) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for New England Revolution in Major League Soccer. He began his career at Valencia, playing mostly in their reserves and making his debut with the first team in 2014. He also spent two seasons on loan at Elche, winning promotion to La Liga in 2013.

Cody Baker is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back or right-back for Sacramento Republic FC of the USL Championship, on loan from Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC. Club career Born in Washington, Baker joined the youth setup of Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC in 2018.
Diego Santiago Fagúndez Pepe (born 14 February 1995) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution.
Donovan Jivan Parisian (born September 27, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution.
Dor David Turgeman (born 24 October 2003) is an Israeli professional footballer who plays as a forward for the New England Revolution and the Israel national team.

Ethan Kohler (born May 20, 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender or defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution. Club career Kohler is a youth product of the San Jose Earthquakes academy, and began his senior career with their reserves in the MLS Next Pro in 2022.
Griffin McDorman Yow (born September 25, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution.

Ilay Feingold (also spelled Faingold, Hebrew: עיליי פיינגולד; born 23 August 2004) is an Israeli professional footballer who plays as a right-back or centre-back for the Major League Soccer club New England Revolution. He formerly played for Israeli Premier League club Maccabi Haifa and the Israel national team.

Jack David Harrison (born 20 November 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Italian Serie A club Fiorentina on loan from Premier League club Leeds United. He was selected as the #1 overall pick in the 2016 MLS SuperDraft and was rated as the second best player in MLS under the age of 24 the same year.

Jackson William Yueill is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution. Career College Yueill played two years of college soccer at UCLA between 2015 and 2016, where he was named NSCAA First Team All-Far West Region and First Team All-Pac-12 Conference both years.

Joshua Liam Wynder (born May 2, 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Liga Portugal 2 club Benfica B. Wynder signed a USL Academy contract with USL Championship side Louisville City in February 2021. On June 3, 2021, Wynder signed a professional deal with the club.
Keegan Monroe Hughes (born July 22, 2000) is an American soccer player who plays for Birmingham Legion Major, on loan from MLS club New England Revolution.
Leonardo Campana Romero (born 24 July 2000) is an Ecuadorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution and the Ecuador national team.
Luca Daniel Langoni (born 9 February 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a forward for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution.

Malcolm Curtenius Fry (born May 15, 2005) is an American professional soccer player who plays as forward for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution. Fry joined the Revolution Academy in 2019. He played for the u19 team when they won the 2022 MLS NEXT Cup. On October 28, 2022, he signed his first contract with Revolution II in MLS Next Pro.

Mamadou Fofana (born 21 January 1998), also known as Nojo, is a Malian professional footballer who plays as a defender for MLS side New England Revolution and the Mali national team. Club career Fofana transferred to Alanyaspor in 2016, joining from the academy of Stade Malien. Fofana made his professional debut for Alanyaspor in a 2–3 Süper Lig loss to Çaykur Rizespor on 14 January 2017.

Marcos Alberto Zambrano Delgado (born January 20, 2005) is a professional soccer player who plays as a forward for New England Revolution on loan from Real Salt Lake. Born in Ecuador, he represents the United States at youth level. Early life Zambrano was born in Guayaquil, Ecuador.

Marko Mitrović (born 8 July 1978) is a Serbian football coach who is the head coach of the New England Revolution in Major League Soccer. He previously served as the head coach of the United States U20 national team. A versatile midfielder, he could operate as a holding midfielder or a box to box player and spent most of his professional career in Serbia where he represented eight clubs.

Matthew Ryan Polster (born June 8, 1993) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution. On January 15, 2015, Polster was selected as the 7th overall pick by the Chicago Fire during the 2015 MLS SuperDraft and was signed to a contract on February 4.

Matthew Charles Turner (born June 24, 1994) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lyon, and the United States national team. A resident of Park Ridge, New Jersey, Turner attended Saint Joseph Regional High School.
Peyton James Miller (born November 8, 2007) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution.

James Tanner Beason is an American professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution. Career Youth, college & amateur Beason played as part of the USSDA academy side North Carolina Fusion, before heading to Stanford University in 2015 to play college soccer.

Tylon Christopher Smith (born 9 May 2005) is a South African soccer player who plays as a central defender for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution, on loan from EFL Championship side Queens Park Rangers. He represents the South Africa national team internationally. Smith was voted player of the tournament at the 2025 U-20 Africa Cup of Nations
William Franklin Sands (born July 6, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution.
